title: The Best Vegan Tzatziki
description: Cool, garlicky cucumber dip made with thick plant-based yogurt, lemon and fresh dill. Great with veggies, GF pita chips or grilled skewers.
swaps: Use a thick coconut or soy Greek-style yogurt (not almond or cashew).
watch: Check the vegan yogurt is not nut-based.

title: Mango Salsa with Bell Pepper and Lime
description: Sweet ripe mango, crunchy red pepper, red onion and jalapeño tossed with lime and cilantro. Bright with corn chips or spooned over grilled fish.

title: Roasted Red Pepper Dip (Nut-Free Muhammara)
description: A smoky, gently spicy muhammara-style dip that swaps the usual walnuts for toasted sunflower seeds, served as a snack platter with crunchy raw veggies.
swaps: Use gluten-free panko or GF breadcrumbs; swap the flatbreads for GF flatbread or GF crackers.
watch: Check roasted peppers in oil and sunflower seeds for nut cross-contact.

title: Vegan French Onion Dip
description: Slow-caramelized sweet onions folded into a silky blended-tofu base for a dairy-free take on the classic chip dip. No cashews needed.
swaps: Use GF tamari + a splash of balsamic instead of vegan Worcestershire; use a nut-free dairy-free butter.
watch: Vegan butters can contain nut oils (e.g., cashew/almond) — check label.

title: White Bean Dip with Olives
description: Creamy blended white beans with tahini, lemon and garlic, swirled with chopped black olives for a salty, savory bite.

title: Lemon-Garlic Edamame Dip
description: A vibrant green, protein-packed dip of edamame and cannellini beans with lemon, garlic and smoked paprika. Perfect with crudités.
swaps: Serve with veggies or certified GF crackers.

title: Authentic Pico de Gallo
description: The classic fresh salsa: chopped tomato, onion, jalapeño and cilantro brightened with lime and salt. Five minutes and endlessly useful.
watch: Serve with corn tortilla chips labeled gluten-free.

title: Ceviche de Pescado
description: Firm white fish 'cooked' in fresh lime juice with red onion, cilantro and a hint of habanero. Light, tangy and great on corn tostadas.
watch: Fish only (no shrimp). Use very fresh fish.

title: Shoyu Ahi Poke
description: Cubes of sashimi-grade tuna tossed in a savory shoyu-sesame dressing with sweet onion and scallions, Hawaiian style.
swaps: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce; omit the macadamia nuts (or use toasted sesame seeds).
watch: Contains macadamia nuts as written — must omit.

title: Salmon Tartare with Chive Tomatoes
description: Finely diced fresh salmon dressed with lemon, mustard, capers and chives, topped with a bright cherry-tomato relish.
swaps: Serve on cucumber rounds or GF crackers instead of baguette.
watch: Use sushi-grade salmon; check whole-grain mustard for malt vinegar.

title: Turkish Stuffed Grape Leaves (Yalancı Dolma)
description: Tender vine leaves rolled around herbed rice with currants and mint, then simmered in lemon and olive oil. Served cool as part of a mezze spread.
watch: Pine nuts listed as optional — leave out.

title: Melon and Prosciutto Skewers
description: Sweet cantaloupe, salty prosciutto and fresh basil threaded on picks and finished with a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
swaps: Omit the mini mozzarella balls (or use a nut-free dairy-free mozzarella).
watch: Check balsamic glaze for thickeners/additives.

title: Rosemary Bacon Wrapped Dates
description: Sticky Medjool dates wrapped in crisp bacon and finished with rosemary and flaky salt — sweet, salty and always the first to disappear.
swaps: Skip the optional goat cheese filling.
watch: Choose gluten-free bacon.

title: Salmon Skewers with a Lemon Sauce
description: Bite-size salmon cubes seared on toothpicks and spooned with a garlicky lemon-dill olive oil sauce. A quick Spanish-style tapa.

title: Tuna Skewers with Olives and Capers
description: Seared tuna chunks threaded with briny Spanish olives and capers, finished with lemon and good olive oil.

title: Garlic Mushrooms with Spanish Padrón Peppers
description: Blistered padrón peppers and button mushrooms sautéed with garlic, white wine and smoked paprika — a classic tapas-bar plate.

title: Beijing Lamb Skewers (Yangrou Chuan)
description: Street-food lamb skewers grilled hot and showered with toasted cumin and chili flakes. Simple, smoky and addictive.

title: Chicken Satay Skewers (SunButter Sauce)
description: Turmeric-and-ginger marinated chicken strips grilled with red peppers and dunked in a creamy, tangy dipping sauce.
swaps: Swap the peanut butter for SunButter (sunflower seed butter); use GF tamari for all soy sauce; skip the chopped peanuts (use toasted sunflower or sesame seeds).
watch: Recipe is peanut-based as written — the SunButter swap is required.

title: Grilled Jerk Chicken Skewers
description: Chicken thighs marinated in a fiery Scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme jerk paste, then charred on the grill.
swaps: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce.

title: Rice Paper Dumplings
description: Gyoza-style dumplings with a tofu, mushroom and cabbage filling wrapped in rice paper and pan-fried until chewy and crisp — no wheat wrappers.
swaps: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce.

title: Crispy Homestyle Pakora
description: Onion, potato and cabbage fritters in a spiced chickpea-flour (besan) batter, fried until lacy and crunchy. Serve with mint chutney.
watch: Besan is naturally GF but buy a brand with no wheat cross-contact; check chaat masala/hing blends for wheat.

title: Hara Bhara Kebab
description: Bright green spinach, pea and potato patties seasoned with ginger, chili and chaat masala, pan-fried until golden.
watch: Check chaat masala for wheat/hing additives.

title: Honey Sesame Chickpea Lettuce Wraps
description: Crispy chickpeas glazed in a sticky honey-sesame-lime sauce and spooned into butter lettuce cups.
swaps: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce.

title: Marinated Olives
description: A trio of olives steeped in olive oil with lemon zest, garlic, thyme and rosemary. Make ahead and set out for any gathering.

title: Sweet Potato Bites with Avocado and Bacon
description: Roasted sweet potato rounds topped with a lime-smoky avocado mash and crumbled bacon. Naturally gluten- and dairy-free.
watch: Choose gluten-free bacon.

title: Chocolate Seed Bites
description: No-bake bites of pumpkin, sunflower, hemp and chia seeds blended with dates and allergy-friendly chocolate chips.
watch: Use top-8-free chocolate chips (e.g., Enjoy Life); sprinkles must be GF.

title: Chocolate-Covered Banana SunButter Bites
description: Banana coins sandwiched with SunButter and dipped in dairy-free chocolate, then frozen — like little nice-cream bonbons.
watch: Use allergy-friendly chocolate chips (e.g., Enjoy Life).

title: Pumpkin Seed Bars
description: Larabar-style bars of dates, pumpkin and sunflower seeds, coconut and cranberries with a hint of ginger and cinnamon. Nut-free and no-bake.
watch: Check seeds for nut cross-contact.

title: Chocolate Coconut Macaroons (No-Bake)
description: Five-ingredient, egg-free macaroons of shredded coconut, cocoa, coconut oil and maple syrup — fudgy little truffles straight from the fridge.

title: Coconut Lime Macaroons
description: Egg-free macaroons bound with coconut butter and maple syrup and brightened with fresh lime zest and juice.

title: Vegan Pumpkin Muffins
description: Tender maple-sweetened pumpkin muffins with warm spices and a crackly cinnamon-sugar top.
swaps: Use Bob's Red Mill Gluten-Free 1-to-1 Baking Flour (the author's tested GF option); use coconut oil rather than vegan butter for the topping.
watch: If using vegan butter, check it is nut-free.

title: No-Bake Coconut Date Balls
description: Gooey cooked dates and crispy rice rolled in shredded coconut — an old-fashioned holiday treat made allergy-friendly.
swaps: Use a dairy-free margarine; use a certified gluten-free crispy rice cereal.
watch: Regular crispy rice cereal contains barley malt — must use a GF brand.

title: Air Fryer Plantains
description: Ripe plantain slices air-fried until caramelized and crisp at the edges — sweet, salty and three ingredients.

title: Patacones (Tostones)
description: Green plantains fried, smashed and fried again into crunchy golden rounds. Great alone or as a base for guac and pico.

title: Salt and Vinegar Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas with a tangy red wine vinegar finish — all the salt-and-vinegar chip flavor with protein.

title: Spicy Edamame with Chili Garlic
description: Edamame pods tossed in a sizzling garlic-ginger, sambal and sesame glaze — the izakaya-style snack at home.
swaps: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce.
watch: Use a rice- or soy-based white miso (some miso contains barley); check mirin label.

title: Baked Potato Skin Chips
description: Leftover potato peels tossed with oil and salt and baked into crispy, zero-waste chips.

title: Red Lentil Crackers (Lentil Chips)
description: Crisp, naturally gluten-free crackers made from soaked red lentils, rosemary and paprika — sturdy enough for any dip.

title: Spicy Seaweed Tofu Rolls
description: Strips of tofu wrapped in nori, pan-fried crisp and glazed in a sticky lemongrass-chili sauce.
swaps: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce.
watch: Check sweet chili sauce label.

title: Air Fryer Polenta Fries
description: Tube polenta cut into sticks, seasoned with herbs and garlic and air-fried until crisp outside and creamy inside.
watch: Check prepared polenta tube label.
